name: standing-two-arm-tricep-cable-extension.html
instructions:
1. Set up by attaching a single grip handle to each of the high pulley cables and selecting the weight you want to use on the stack.
2. Grip each cable with an underhand grip (palms facing up). You will grab the right handle with your left hand and the left handle with your right hand.
3. Stand in the center of the machine and lift the handles so that your upper arms are parallel to the floor and the handles are the front of your face around level with your ears. This is the starting position.
4. Keeping your upper arms and body fixed, push the handles out away from your body as far as possible.
5. Once you have fully extended both arms, pause and then slowly bring the handles back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for desired reps.
